visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at night in a bustling urban plaza with a massive illuminated American flag billboard as the backdrop. A young woman with dark hair, wearing a black leather jacket and an orange pleated skirt, stands with her back to the camera while wearing large over-ear headphones. (2) She begins to dance energetically, turning around to face the camera with a wide smile and expressive hand gestures. The camera moves in a low-angle tracking motion, capturing her movements against the backdrop of bright digital billboards including Dave & Buster's, Netflix, and Nasdaq. (3) The focus shifts to a man in a black jacket and grey denim pants, also wearing headphones, who stands in the middle of the crowded square. He holds his hands to his headphones and shouts toward the sky with a strained facial expression, mimicking a passionate performance while passers-by walk through the background under bright artificial lighting.
